title: A hot-Jupiter control in two Gaia XP catalogues shows quiet main-sequence dust dimmers are less metal-rich than hot-Jupiter hosts at equal magnitude; Gaia scatter biases most campaign dimmers
abstract: Question: Do main-sequence dust dimmers have metal-rich hosts, as giant-planet hosts do? A prior campaign test with one Gaia XP catalogue gave beta = 0.85 (95 %: 0 to 1.8) and could not exclude beta = 2. Approach: We ranked the XP metallicity of each host among Gaia DR3 stars of the same field, G, BP-RP and parallax. We used two catalogues (Zhang, Green and Rix 2023, ZGR23; Andrae, Rix and Chandra 2023, AN23) and ran the identical test on 624 transiting hot-Jupiter hosts as a positive control. Results: Field stars with 1.5-10 times the normal Gaia G scatter read 0.2-0.35 dex metal-poor in ZGR23 (0.02-0.14 dex in AN23). 27 of 78 dimmers have such scatter, including 8 of 9 campaign field-dwarf dimmers such as Gaia20cdd, so XP values cannot test them. Quiet hot-Jupiter hosts have mean rank 0.75 (ZGR23) and 0.77 (AN23), z near 20, and keep it at G > 14. Quiet dimmers (mostly ZTF dippers, median G 16.5) have 0.58 (0.50-0.66, n = 51) and 0.48 (0.39-0.56, n = 48). At the same G, hot-Jupiter hosts rank 0.17 (0.05-0.28) and 0.25 (0.12-0.37) higher (p = 0.003 and 0.001). The dimmer metallicity preference is at most 0.74 (ZGR23) and 0.28 (AN23) times the hot-Jupiter value (95 %). Conclusion: A hot-Jupiter-like metallicity dependence is disfavoured for these dimmers; field-like or weak dependence is allowed. Limitations: hot-Jupiter hosts reach only G of about 16, the quiet dimmers are almost all ZTF dippers, and no dimmer has a spectrum. Right: injection curves that convert mean rank to the tilt beta_obs in the dimmer fields, with the dimmer value and the hot-Jupiter value at the dimmer magnitudes (95 percent bands).

XP metallicity minus the field median against Gaia DR3 G scatter relative to matched field stars. Squares: medians of 23,647 (dimmer fields) and 69,793 (hot-Jupiter fields) field stars. Points: dimmers. ZGR23 values read 0.2-0.35 dex low at 1.5-10 times the normal scatter; AN23 much less. Most campaign dimmers are in the high-scatter region.

Cumulative distribution of the metallicity rank of quiet dust dimmers and of quiet hot-Jupiter hosts with G > 14, for both catalogues. The dashed line is the expectation for no metallicity dependence.
